contracts.northstar: Whole-thesis drafting, designed from measured costs
contracts.negative: Usage reaching the threshold after step k pauses the job with step k+1 pending, and after a restart and the reset it resumes at step k+1 with no step run twice and no proposal duplicated.

contracts.northstar: Whole-thesis drafting, designed from measured costs
contracts.negative: A server killed during a step retries that step after the restart, its proposals exist once and no half-written proposal is visible.

contracts.northstar: Quotes, pages, numbers and cite keys are checked by code, never by a model
contracts.negative: Drafts with a cite key outside the library, an unbacked number, a fabricated quote and an underived printed page are rejected inside propose_edit and never stored as proposals.

contracts.northstar: every change they make is a reviewable proposal
contracts.negative: Accept-all with a red trace check applies nothing, and a deletion over more than three blocks, a rawLatex change and an externally influenced deletion stay pending for a single review.

contracts.northstar: AI provenance is never silently lost
contracts.negative: A step whose drafts the validator all rejected has no annex entry, and the number of annex entries equals the job's applied or user-rejected proposals.

contracts.northstar: no automatic marker reaches the thesis
contracts.negative: An export without the annex request holds no model id and no agent id in the .tex, the PDF text or the PDF metadata.

contracts.northstar: People and agents write together at the same time
contracts.negative: When two chapter jobs target one block, the second waits as blocked-by-claim and its proposal for the claimed block is refused with claimed.

contracts.northstar: every change they make is a reviewable proposal
contracts.negative: A chapter that is not approved runs none of its steps, and an abort leaves the stored state and no applied change.

contracts.northstar: written design approved by the judge panel
contracts.operator: The judge panel (.claude/workflows/ar-judge.js with model fable) approves the T45 design and records the verdict in the T45 ticket; the release panel (.claude/workflows/ar-release.js) repeats the check in docs/release/<version>.md.
contracts.source: #104 context and AC17; T45; operator decision 6 of 2026-10-20
